record.paper_title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
record.context_brief: Structure theorem for round matroids excluding a uniform minor
record.original_question: For positive integers a and b, can one find a qualitative structure theorem for the class of round matroids with no U_{a,b}-minor? A matroid is round when it does not contain two disjoint cocircuits.

evidence.quote: Recall that a matroid is round if it does not contain two disjoint cocircuits.
Problem 10.1. Let a and b be positive integers. Find a qualitative structure theorem for the class of round matroids with no Ua,b-minor.

artifact.self_contained_problem: A matroid $M$ is called round if it does not contain two disjoint cocircuits. For positive integers $a$ and $b$, let $U_{a,b}$ denote the uniform matroid of rank $a$ on $b$ elements (the matroid on a $b$-element ground set whose independent sets are all subsets of size at most $a$). Given positive integers $a$ and $b$, give a qualitative structure theorem describing the class of all round matroids that do not contain $U_{a,b}$ as a minor. More precisely, exhibit a list of basic constructions (such as matroids representable over specified finite fields, Dowling-type matroids, their duals, and bounded modifications thereof) and prove that every round matroid with no $U_{a,b}$-minor can be obtained from these basic classes in a controlled (e.g., tree-like) way.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is part of an ongoing research program on excluding uniform matroids as minors. While partial structural results exist (for example, that round matroids of sufficiently high rank contain a $U_{k,2k}$-, $M(K_k)$-, or $B(K_k)$-minor), no full qualitative structure theorem for round matroids excluding an arbitrary $U_{a,b}$-minor appears in the literature. It remains open.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 10.1. Let a and b be positive integers. Find a qualitative structure theorem for the class of round matroids with no U_{a,b}-minor.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Structure in Minor-Closed Classes of Matroids
status_evidence.snippet: Hope for constructive structural description of matroids with no U_{a,b}-minor, analogous to Graph Minors Structure Theorem.
status_evidence.claim: Full structure theorem remains a research goal, not yet achieved.
